review_notes: I read the whole file and checked its three structures (UnboundedRitzPair, ReducingComplement, ReflectionIntertwines) against Mathlib and the repo. My Mathlib searches found no reducing-subspace notion for partial linear maps and no analogue of these bundles. I also searched for `reflectionOperator` under Mathlib's InnerProductSpace directory and found only `Submodule.reflection`, an isometry equivalence, so it is not a competing structure. The only overlaps are inside the repo, not Mathlib. ReducingComplement is the weaker "Vᗮ commutes with A" consequence of the repo's TauCeti.LinearPMap.ReducesSubspace, and `ofReducesSubspace` is a deliberate documented bridge to it. The repo also has `Reduces` definitions in SolutionPrelude.lean and ReducingSubspace.lean, but they sit in other files and are not Mathlib. UnboundedRitzPair.ofTrialBlock builds its compression data the same way as UnboundedCompressionTrialData.ofBounded, but from a different input type (BoundedCompressionTrialBlock rather than Theorem63TrialData), so it is a named adapter and not a competing concept. I could not clearly show a practical cost from consolidating any of these, so I abstain. I did not inspect all uses of these structures downstream.
